title: Single global Mutex<Connection> serializes all DB access
evidence: lib.rs:16 Database(Arc<Mutex<Connection>>); every handler locks the one connection in db.run (lib.rs:103)
suggestion: For higher concurrency use a connection pool (e.g. r2d2/deadpool). Not a defect at this task's scale; correct and race-free as written.

title: ?author= filter is exact case-sensitive match, not substring
evidence: lib.rs:195 WHERE (?1 IS NULL OR author = ?1); README documents it as exact. TASK.md only requires an ?author= filter without specifying match semantics.
suggestion: Acceptable per spec; a LIKE/partial match could be offered if fuzzy filtering is desired.
